title: Hit or Miss
text:
Hit or Miss. I wanted to wait awhile before my review. I use to rate purchases shortly after I received them but soon found out not all are as they seem.
These charcoals are a hit a miss. Some light easy; others won’t like at all. Some lite fully and get red; other are red in a few areas
After us two rolls of charcoal my suggestion is try some other brand
These are inconsistent and poor quality
